description: Senator George Borrello is among plaintiffs challenging the Department of Health’s authority to enact controversial policy through rule-making process ALBANY, NY – Senator George Borrello is part of a lawsuit filed in State Supreme Court today challenging the constitutionality of a New York State Department of Health regulation, on the grounds it violates the separation of powers.
